name: ImpulseLog
description: ImpulseLog helps people pause impulse purchases, log resisted purchases and almost-buys, notice spending patterns, and build savings habits with wait timers, goals, streaks, and ADHD-friendly gamification.

core_workflow: log a resisted purchase or almost-buy
share a product link from another app to pause or record it
pause an unsure purchase with a wait timer
review patterns across mood, category, place, and time
make progress toward optional savings goals
free_features: saved, bought, and pending decision logging
optional mood, place, notes, and categories
goals, milestones, streaks, XP, and daily challenges
one personalized Coach sample review after 3 completed decisions
Share to Pause from the iOS Share Sheet
optional_premium_features: fresh weekly Coach reviews with a practical next step and optional check-in
deeper Coach pattern reviews based on the user's decision history
up to one year of mood history
deeper mood, place, category, and impulse patterns

pricing.authority: The US App Store purchase sheet is authoritative for current US pricing. Local pricing may differ outside the United States.

privacy.place_context: Optional and added by the user when it is useful.
privacy.share_extension: Reads and saves only item details and links the user explicitly shares.
privacy.coach_history: May retain generated reviews, chosen next steps, optional check-in timing, and follow-up responses for the signed-in account.

accuracy.positioning: Impulse-control and intentional-spending app with an optional coaching feature.
accuracy.operator: TheLocalLookoutLLC, owner and operator of ImpulseLog
accuracy.avoided_spending_rule: An amount is recorded as not spent; it is assigned or secured only when the user explicitly records that later action.
